cross_threshold_4_0_vs_4_5._retraction: The disjointness verdicts recorded in this object are VACUOUS as evidence and were removed from the prose. With the truth cut pinned and predictions fixed, specificity is monotone non-decreasing in the threshold and recall monotone non-increasing, BY CONSTRUCTION -- so a disjointness test on them answers nothing. The instrument also self-contradicts: 4.0 vs 4.25 bands OVERLAP, which would make a provably-signed improvement 'not distinguishable'. The bands remain valid as uncertainty on each single point estimate. The counts and rates in this file are unaffected and were independently reproduced.

cross_box.conclusion: SUPERSEDED TWICE, settled 2026-08-10 evening. (1) The band-overlap reading first recorded here was the WRONG INSTRUMENT: the #95 band answers 'what if BATCH COMPOSITION changed', and parity runs hold batch composition fixed, so it cannot license 'indistinguishable'. (2) The replacement claim -- that pinning production's library stack made agreement WORSE -- was CONFOUNDED (it compared a mismatched-stack CPU run against a matched-stack CUDA run). A fourth run decomposes it one variable at a time: HOST contributes NOTHING (gpu-server CPU vs b650 CPU on production's pins is 660/660 bit-identical, 0 flips at every threshold); the LIBRARY STACK is worth 3 flips at 4.5; CPU->CUDA is worth 3 flips at 4.5 and 1 at the deployed 4.0. So a dev box CAN be cleared by pinning versions, completely, and the b650_specificity column below reflects a MISMATCHED stack. None of this touches #102's conclusion: the box effect is 0.0068 specificity against a 4.0->4.5 gain of 0.054. See docs/evidence/2026-08-10-b650-gpu-production-stack-parity.md.

constraint_found.what: MAX_NORMALIZATION_RAW_MIN = 4.5 bounds the op-point from above.
constraint_found.detail: tests/unit/test_normalization_invariant.py requires normalization.json stats.raw_min == the filter's tier threshold, and NexusMind/src/scoring/production_scorer.py rejects a fit with raw_min > 4.5 (strict >, so exactly 4.5 is accepted) -- falling back to score_scale_factor with only a log warning. uplifting v7's committed fit has raw_min 4.0, n=18130. So 4.5 is reachable but sits ON the bound with ZERO margin; 4.75 and 5.0 are NOT reachable without raising the constant in BOTH repos.
constraint_found.consequence: any op-point move requires refitting normalization.json at the new anchor in the same change.
